name: Vyanet Bend

nadir.desc: The property consists of a multi-section commercial building complex with metal roofs|A large paved parking lot is located between and in front of the structures and holds numerous vehicles|Landscaped plantings, trees, and islands are present throughout the parking area|Sidewalks and marked parking spaces support vehicle and pedestrian circulation|The property is located in a commercial and light industrial area.

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows the main commercial buildings facing a paved parking lot|Multiple vehicles are parked in marked spaces|Landscaped plantings and trees are present along the building frontage and parking edges|Sidewalks provide pedestrian access.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows the side elevation of the commercial buildings and portions of the paved parking lot|Trees and landscaped areas border this side|Vehicles and circulation lanes are visible.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows the back elevations of the commercial buildings|Trees and open ground continue around the rear perimeter.

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows the side of the commercial buildings and paved parking areas|Multiple vehicles are parked along this elevation|Landscaped plantings and trees frame portions of this side of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from multiple points via the large paved parking lot that surrounds and connects the commercial buildings. The parking lot provides substantial space for emergency vehicle circulation and staging. Multiple vehicles currently occupy portions of the lot. Landscaped islands and trees are present but do not fully obstruct access. Sidewalks support pedestrian movement around the buildings. Neighboring commercial structures are present in the surrounding area.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the parking lot, and are any of them gated or restricted? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the buildings? Are there multiple points of entry into each building section? Is vehicle access available on all sides of the facility? What is the primary use of the individual building sections on the property?
